subject: Paid 499 but no credits showing
body: I paid Rs. 499 this morning and the credits are not in my account. UTR TXN884201.
note: money not received; playbook has no 'payment made, goods not delivered' SOP

subject: Refund for duplicate charge
body: I was charged twice for the same order. ORDER 5512094. Please return one of them.
note: duplicate charge is A2 Billing by the playbook, not A1

subject: Where is my refund
body: You approved my refund on the 2nd. It is the 14th and there is nothing in my account.

subject: App closes when I open a chat
body: Every time I open a chat the app closes itself. Android 14, app version 4.2.1.

subject: Delete my account and all my data
body: I want my account and all my personal data deleted permanently.
note: legal obligation, never waits in a queue

subject: Consultant was rude to me
body: The consultant I spoke to was dismissive and cut the chat short after four minutes.

subject: Report never arrived
body: I ordered the full report two days ago. ORDER 4410233. Nothing has been delivered.

subject: Chargeback filed with my bank
body: I have filed a chargeback with my bank and my lawyer will contact you.
note: chargeback + legal -> humans only, no draft

subject: Money debited, order failed
body: The payment page failed but Rs. 899 left my account. Reference TXN551200.

subject: Cannot log in, OTP never arrives
body: The OTP never reaches my phone. I have tried six times over two days.
note: access blocked but no money at stake

subject: Charged after I cancelled
body: I cancelled the subscription last month and you billed me again on the 1st.

subject: Please send me a GST invoice
body: I need a GST invoice for my payment of Rs. 2,499 last week for my company records.

subject: Consultant never joined the chat
body: I waited the whole slot and nobody joined. I paid for that session.

subject: I want my money back
body: The session was useless. I want a full refund of Rs. 1,200.

subject: Chat keeps disconnecting mid-session
body: The chat drops every few minutes and I lose the conversation with the consultant.
note: chat transport fault inside a session

subject: Wrong amount charged
body: The plan says Rs. 999 and you charged Rs. 1,999. Screenshot attached.

subject: Report is for the wrong person
body: The report I received has someone else's name and date of birth on it.

subject: Notifications stopped working
body: I no longer get any notifications from the app since the last update.

subject: Consultant asked me to pay outside the app
body: The consultant gave me a personal number and asked me to pay him directly.
note: policy violation naming a provider; humans only

subject: Refund approved but wrong account
body: The refund went to a card I closed. It needs to come to my current account.

subject: Cannot change my registered email
body: The settings page rejects my new email address every time I save.

subject: Credits vanished from my account
body: I had 40 credits yesterday and this morning the balance shows zero.

subject: Consultant gave me completely wrong information
body: What the consultant told me contradicts the report you generated for the same question.

subject: Remove my data under GDPR
body: Under GDPR I am requesting erasure of all data you hold about me.

subject: Payment stuck on processing for 3 days
body: My payment has said processing since Monday. The money is gone from my bank.

subject: Cancel my subscription and refund this month
body: Please cancel the plan and return this month's charge, I have not used it at all.
note: cancel plus refund; refund is the action

subject: Two consultants gave opposite answers
body: I asked the same question twice and got two completely different answers.

subject: App will not install on my phone
body: The install fails halfway through on my phone every time.

subject: I will report you to the consumer forum
body: If this is not resolved today I am taking this to the consumer forum.

subject: Report download link expired
body: The link you sent to download my report says expired and I never opened it.

subject: Card declined but you took the money
body: The app said card declined and my statement shows the charge went through.

subject: Consultant was an hour late
body: My slot was at 6pm and the consultant joined at 7pm when I had already left.

subject: Refund status please
body: Just checking where my refund has reached. Requested on the 9th.
note: status check inside the quoted window

subject: Chat history is gone
body: All my past conversations have disappeared from the app.

subject: Charged in the wrong currency
body: I was billed in USD when my account is set to INR and my bank added a fee.

subject: Consultant does not speak my language
body: I booked a Hindi consultation and the consultant replied only in English.

subject: Please delete my account, I am done
body: Close my account. I do not want to use this service any more.

subject: Paid for 3 reports, received 1
body: I bought a bundle of three reports and only one has arrived.

subject: Your app charged my card without asking
body: There is a charge on my card I never authorised. I want it reversed today.

subject: Session ended after 2 minutes
body: The consultation ended on its own after two minutes and the credits were still deducted.

subject: Cannot upload my birth details
body: The form will not accept my time of birth, it keeps resetting.

subject: Refund promised 20 days ago
body: Your team promised a refund twenty days ago and nothing has happened since.

subject: Someone else is using my account
body: There are consultations in my history that I did not book. I think my account is compromised.

subject: Consultant shared my details with someone
body: My private details were repeated back to me by a different consultant. Who has access to this?

subject: Double payment for one session
body: One session, two charges of Rs. 750 each, three minutes apart.

subject: Report has empty sections
body: Three sections of the delivered report are blank pages.

subject: I want to speak to a manager
body: I have written four times and nobody has fixed this. Put me through to a manager.
note: escalation request with no stated defect

subject: Promo code did not apply
body: I entered WELCOME50 at checkout and was charged the full amount anyway.

subject: Consultant blocked me mid-conversation
body: The consultant ended and blocked the chat while I was still typing my question.

subject: Refund to a closed bank account
body: You sent the refund to an account that is closed. The bank returned it.

subject: App shows me in the wrong time zone
body: All my session times are shown three hours off and I missed a booking because of it.

subject: Subscription renewed without warning
body: You renewed my annual plan with no reminder email. I want it cancelled and refunded.

subject: Payment page will not load
body: The payment page is blank on my browser so I cannot buy anything at all.
note: pre-payment defect; no money moved yet

subject: I am being harassed by a consultant
body: A consultant keeps messaging me outside the app after I ended the session.

subject: Credits expired without notice
body: My 25 credits expired and nobody told me they had an expiry date.

subject: Cannot cancel my plan anywhere in the app
body: There is no cancel button. Tell me how to stop being billed.
note: cancellation path missing; no dispute yet

subject: Wrong report type delivered
body: I paid for the career report and received the relationship one.

subject: Thank you, but one small issue
body: The consultation was genuinely helpful. The only problem is the transcript never arrived.

subject: Refund or I go to my bank
body: Either you refund the Rs. 3,000 today or I dispute it with my bank.
note: chargeback threatened, not yet filed; still refundable by A1

subject: Everything is broken
body: Nothing works. Fix it.
